answer: Each new attendance token embeds a hash of the holder's previous event token, forming a chain that the cipher of the design makes tamper-evident across the whole season. The hollow of the scheme is that a break in the chain reveals a fabricated history, so a fresh account cannot claim a long attendance record it never earned. A Sybil would need to forge an entire chain of past events, and the reef of the chaining means one fake link invalidates everything after it.
